page0.text:
It feels like I just got punched.
"...Oh."
I wake up from the pain in my shoulder.
...My body is still intact.
I can still feel my limbs and hear the sound of my own breathing.
My shoulder is wrapped in a bandage, and the bed I'm sleeping in is soft.

page1.text:
"...Huh? This place... Is...?"
...An unfamiliar room.
If I remember correctly... Someone said something.

page2.text: This is it. You don't have to fight anymore, Shirou...

page3.text:
"Guh...!"
I get up.
I remember everything and jump out of bed...
"Guh...!"
Pain causes my back to arch.

page4.text:
"Agh... Khh...!"
...I touch my left shoulder.
It still burns like fire.
It feels much worse than a pulled muscle.
Well, I'm lucky that my arm is still attached since it was pierced through with a sword, but... Honestly... It hurts badly.

page5.text:
"Guh... Ah, ah, ha..."
I slowly get out of bed.
If I clench my teeth, I can somehow bear this pain.
Then...

page6.text:
...
...The heat from my shoulder reaches my head.
I shake that off and move my legs.
"...No one's... Here?"
Yeah, there shouldn't be anyone.
I remember Tohsaka's words.
She said those words and left.
So, she must've gone out to fight by herself.
"Haah... Haah, ah..."
I head to the door.
I must go outside.
I need to go outside and find Tohsaka.
"Khh..."
I'm going to fall.
I almost fall, so I support myself using the dressing table.
"Guh..."
...It's useless.
I fall to the floor along with the dressing table that I leaned on.

page7.text:
"Sorry... I made a mess, Tohsaka."
I collect the scattered accessories and put them back.
"...Huh?"
I see something familiar amongst them.

page8.text:
"...I've seen this before..."
I've seen this somewhere.
...Yeah, it was like this back then too.
The night I got stabbed in the chest by Lancer.
I got a fatal wound, and it was healed before I knew it.
I think there was something I picked up when I left the hallway with a sluggish body.

page9.text:
It's hot.
The poison from my shoulder circulates to my brain and makes me lax.

page10.text:
"...Yeah. This is the same one..."
I can tell, but I can't gather my thoughts.
Things that I had believed were dreams until now…
Or whose Servant was fighting Lancer at that time…
Or who could save me when I was dying, and who had the necessity to be there...

page11.text: ...There's no need to think about those things anymore, yet my head is spinning.

page12.text:
"...Damn it. She talked about owing me and all, but this is something I can never pay back..."
I feel dizzy.
I'm a mess from the pain, heat, and my own stupidity.

page13.text:
"Haah... Ah..."
I move my legs.
Anyway, I have to look for her now.
I have something I want to say, and now I have something I have to tell her.
That's all I can think about with this brain that's as mushy as stew...

page14.text:
"Haah... Haah, haah, ah..."
I was in front of the train station before I realized it.
My hazy mind moves with only vague images.
...That she's there.
It's ordering me to go there to look for her.

page15.text:
...
...I don't know why I'm drawn here.
My boiled brain only thought of this building.

page16.text:
"...!"
...Then, I can only follow my instincts.
I don't have any other way to find Tohsaka to start with.
Whatever that may be, I can only cling to something.

page17.text:
I go out to the rooftop.
The wind that blows high up is cold and cools my heated head down a bit.
"...Why are you here?"
A faint gasp.
Tohsaka was looking down at the town from the rooftop, just as she had been that night.

page18.text:
"Go home. I don't know why you're here, but you're an eyesore."
She looks at me angrily.
Behind me...
There is someone silently telling me that it's not my turn.

page19.text:
"I'm not leaving. I'll leave with you. We promised that we're going to fight together, right?"
I pull my hazy mind together with force and somehow move my mouth.

page20.text:
"Forget about that promise. First of all, what can you even do now? Without Saber, you're no match for a Master."
"...That is—"

page21.text:
"Besides, there's no need for you to fight anymore.
You're not a Master anymore, so it's safe if you escape to the church. You just need to stay there and the Holy Grail War will come to an end."

page22.text:
...
I almost faint hearing those words.
"Don't be ridiculous, I can't leave Saber like that...!
Look, I already said I'm going to fight. So, I'm going to fight until the end no matter—"

page23.text:
"Guh...!"
My vision turns red.
I can't... talk.
Just by yelling, all the muscles in my body cramp up and I feel like I'm going to die.

page24.text:
"Look at yourself. You've had Saber's help until now, but that's what happens without it.
...Look, Emiya. Humans die if they get wounded. Your wound should be fatal."

page25.text:
"Ah... Haah, ah... Ah"
...Damn it.
I know that already.
I know, but I'm in so much pain that the words I need to say can't come out…

page26.text:
"And as for Saber, that's not a problem you should worry about.
You're not a Master anymore, so what happens to Saber doesn't concern you."

page27.text:
...
It does... concern me.
This pain is proof that I've been saved by Saber until now.

page28.text:
"...No, even if I'm not... A Master.
Saber hated it. How can I let her be controlled by someone like that...!?"

page29.text:
"...Yes. But you're powerless.
...It's fine, if you refuse to admit it, then I'll say it for you.
You can't save Saber with the way you are right now."

page30.text:
...
The heat disappears.
Even the boiling in my mind froze with those cold-hearted words.

page31.text:
"End of conversation.
Without Saber, you're no longer a Master.
There's no reason for you to be involved in the kill fest called the Holy Grail War, so withdraw now."

page33.text:
"Ugh...!"
Amidst the wind blowing at the building…
Tohsaka kicks the ground, without any hesitation.
"Idio—Idiot, what are you thinking...!?"
I reach out frantically.

page34.text:
...
There's no need for that.
The red knight appears beside Tohsaka, as if to protect her.
Even if she jumps from this height, she should be able to land without a problem if she has a Servant.

page35.text:
...
Tohsaka's lips move slightly.
...I can't hear what she said.
But her eyes that look at me...

page36.text: You'll die if you get involved any longer.

page37.text: She coldly tells me like it's the final warning.

page38.text:
...
The heat that had cooled down returns.
My thoughts get confused from the pain and heat.

page39.text:
I can't save Saber.
There's no reason for Shirou Emiya to fight.
